raw_text: Breaking: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant in Tamil Nadu has suffered a cyber intrusion. Lazarus Group malware variant found on administrative network systems. The malware targeted HR and procurement databases. NPCIL states operational technology networks remain air-gapped and unaffected. DAE launching security audit of all nuclear facilities. #Kudankulam #CyberAttack #Lazarus
clean_text: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant cyber intrusion detected. Lazarus Group malware on admin network targeting HR and procurement. OT networks unaffected. DAE launching audit.
